The Golden Sayings of Epictetus

True instruction is this:—to learn to wish that each thing should come to pass as it does. And how does it come to pass?

—
XXVI

Epictetus

Harvard Classics, Vol. 2, Part 2

The Golden Sayings of Epictetus

Epictetus

Like those of Socrates and Christ, these aphorisms were transcribed by the disciples of the great Stoic.
